g.text: All values are milliseconds. Ranges are min-max across five process p99 values, not confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #787466

g.text: A median p99 is not a pooled percentile. 1,000 UDP ticks support a limited tail estimate; rare stalls remain uncharacterized.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #787466

g.text: Small absolute differences and shared-host scheduling noise should not be read as universal deployment improvements.
